content.rendered:
Linked here is our Kindergarten Newsletter for all families registering for Ridges Kindergarten this fall.

Included in this newsletter are details about our “Ramp Up” schedule, as well as other important information for the first days of school. If you have any questions over the summer, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We are excited to have you joining us in the fall!

Hope you have a wonderful summer,

Miranda Johnson, Principal
